'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Anglophone Crisis]]
**[[Egbekaw massacre]]
***At least 30 people are killed when [[Tigers of Ambazonia]] [[separatist]]s attack the village of Egbekaw in [[Manyu (department)|Manyu]], [[Southwest Region (Cameroon)|Southwest]] [[Cameroon]]. [https://www.barrons.com/news/20-dead-in-attack-by-anglophone-separatists-in-cameroon-officials-a4bbb74f (AFP via ''Barron's'')] [https://cameroonnewsagency.com/manyu-more-than-30-die-in-amba-attack/ (Cameroon News Agency)]
*[[Arab–Israeli conflict]]
**[[Israel–Hamas war]]
***An [[Israel Border Police]] officer is [[stabbing as a terrorist tactic|stabbed to death]] and another officer is injured near the [[Old City of Jerusalem]]. Responding security forces shoot the [[Palestinian political violence|Palestinian attacker]] dead. [https://www.jta.org/2023/11/06/israel/israeli-american-border-police-officer-20-killed-in-jerusalem-stabbing-attack (Jewish Telegraphic Agency)]
***Three armed [[Palestinians]] are killed and another is injured when Israeli soldiers [[ambush]] a vehicle in [[Tulkarm]] in the [[West Bank]]. [https://english.alarabiya.net/News/middle-east/2023/11/06/Israeli-forces-kill-four-Palestinians-in-occupied-West-Bank-Ministry (AFP via Al Arabiya)]
**[[2024 Iran–Israel conflict]], [[Israel–Hezbollah conflict (2023–present)]]
***[[Al-Qassam Brigades]] launches 16 rockets at areas south of [[Haifa]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israels-military-says-its-striking-hezbollah-targets-lebanon-2023-11-06/ (Reuters)]
***[[Israel Defense Forces|IDF]] spokesperson [[Daniel Hagari]] says that [[fighter aircraft|fighter jets]] have struck a "broad range" of [[Hezbollah]] targets in [[Lebanon]] in response to a barrage of rockets fired at northern [[Israeli cities]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/israels-military-says-its-striking-hezbollah-targets-lebanon-2023-11-06/ (Reuters)]
*[[Myanmar civil war (2021–present)|Myanmar civil war]]
**[[Operation 1027]]
***[[Thailand]] announces its intention to evacuate 162 [[Thai people|Thai]] [[human trafficking]] victims trapped near the Chinese border in Myanmar. [https://www.rfa.org/english/news/myanmar/thai-repatriation-plan-11062023141043.html (Radio Free Asia)]
***The [[Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the People's Republic of China]] urges the [[State Administration Council]] of Myanmar to cooperate with Chinese officials in protecting Chinese border villages, two days after a [[Shell (projectile)|shell]] fired by the [[Tatmadaw]] kills one and wounds several in China. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/china-calls-myanmar-maintain-stability-along-border-through-cooperation-2023-11-06/ (Reuters)]
***The [[United Nations]] expresses concern about heavy fighting in [[Shan State]], noting that over 30,000 people have been displaced thus far. [https://www.barrons.com/news/un-alarmed-at-fighting-in-myanmar-noting-mass-displacement-d923f47a (AFP via ''Barron's'')]
***The [[People's Defence Force (Myanmar)|People's Defence Force]] captures [[Kawlin]] in [[Sagaing Region]] after overrunning junta forces. It is the first district capital to fall to opposition forces. Many soldiers and police officers are reportedly killed. [https://uk.sports.yahoo.com/news/myanmar-resistance-claims-first-capture-164504405.html (AP via Yahoo! News)]
*[[Russian invasion of Ukraine]]
**[[Bombing of Odesa (2022–present)|Bombing of Odesa]]
***[[Russian Armed Forces|Russian forces]] attack [[Odesa]] with [[Unmanned combat aerial vehicle|drones]] and missiles, injuring at least eight people and damaging [[infrastructure]], including the [[Odesa Fine Arts Museum]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/five-injured-arts-museum-damaged-russian-strikes-odesa-ukraine-2023-11-06/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2023 Africa floods]]
**At least 25 people in [[Somalia]] and 15 more in [[Kenya]] are killed during [[flood]]s caused by significant rainfall. Approximately 241 acres of [[Agriculture in Kenya|farmland]] have been destroyed and 1,067 [[livestock]] killed in Kenya, while several homes, bridges and roads are destroyed in Somalia. [https://apnews.com/article/kenya-somalia-floods-el-nino-b8923f83a95ef5eb491c14f94bdf40ed (AP)]
*Fourteen [[Venezuelan diaspora|Venezuelan migrants]] are killed in a fire at a [[Informal housing|housing settlement]] in [[Coronel, Chile|Coronel]], [[Concepción Province, Chile|Concepción]], [[Chile]]. [https://english.mathrubhumi.com/news/world/14-venezuelan-migrants-killed-in-chile-fire-mayor-s-office-1.9051857 (AFP via ''Mathrubhumi'')]
*Two people are killed and two others are injured when a [[tank truck|tanker]] [[explode]]s outside the [[High commissioner (Commonwealth)|High Commission]] of [[Canada]] in [[Abuja]], [[Nigeria]]. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/politics/two-killed-canadian-high-commisison-nigeria-1.7019572 (CBC News)]

'''International relations'''
*[[France–Lebanon relations]]
**[[Minister of the Armed Forces (France)|French Armed Forces Minister]] [[Sébastien Lecornu]] announces that [[France]] will donate dozens of [[Armored car (military)|armoured vehicle]]s to the [[Lebanese Armed Forces|Lebanese military]] to help it carry out patrol missions. [https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/france-give-armoured-vehicles-lebanese-army-defence-minister-2023-11-06/ (Reuters)]
*[[International reactions to the Israel–Hamas war]], [[Israel–South Africa relations]]
**[[South Africa]] recalls its [[ambassador]] to [[Israel]] in response to Israel's [[2023 Israeli invasion of the Gaza Strip|invasion of the Gaza Strip]] and [[Palestinian genocide accusation|accuses Israel of genocide]] in Gaza. [https://www.haaretz.com/world-news/asia-and-australia/2023-11-06/ty-article/south-africa-recalls-ambassador-in-tel-aviv-over-israeli-genocide-in-gaza/0000018b-a528-dc0b-a1cb-e5eeab060000 (Haaretz)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[Antisemitism during the Israel–Hamas war]]
**A woman is arrested after [[Vehicle-ramming attack|ramming her car]] into a [[Black Hebrew Israelite]] school in [[Indianapolis]], [[Indiana]], [[United States]], mistakenly believing it to be an "Israel school." [https://apnews.com/article/indianapolis-building-car-drove-woman-arrested-36d4d8ee1deb3b412e82a8b8b2a863a7 (AP)]
* Opening of [[Éric Dupond-Moretti]]'s trial, the [[Keeper of the Seals of France]] (French Justice Minister), at the [[Cour de Justice de la République]] (a special French court established to try cases of ministerial misconduct), accused of abusing his position as justice minister to order probes targeting magistrates who investigated him, his friends or his former clients. The trial marks the first time in modern France that a government minister has been put on trial while still in office. [https://www.france24.com/en/france/20231106-french-justice-minister-goes-on-trial-over-alleged-abuse-of-office (France 24)]

'''Sports'''
*[[2023 WTA Tour]]
**[[2023 WTA Finals]]
***In [[tennis]], [[Iga Świątek]] of [[Sport in Poland|Poland]] defeats [[Jessica Pegula]] of the [[Tennis in the United States|United States]] in the final, 6–1, 6–0 to win the [[2023 WTA Finals – Singles|singles title]] at the 2023 [[WTA Finals]]. With this win, Świątek regains the [[List of WTA number 1 ranked singles tennis players#By year (continued)|WTA No. 1 ranking]] from [[Aryna Sabalenka]], becoming the [[List of WTA number 1 ranked singles tennis players#Year-end No. 1 players|year-end No. 1]] for a second consecutive year. [https://news.abs-cbn.com/sports/11/07/23/swiatek-reclaims-no1-ranking-after-winning-wta-finals (AFP via ABS-CBN News)]
